sources.entry: 13. Waifu2x - AI-driven image upscaling for anime-style art.

summary.name: waifu2x
summary.one_liner: waifu2x is a web-based image upscaler that uses deep convolutional neural networks to enlarge anime-style art, and it also supports photos.
use_cases: prepare images for large prints or wallpapers
enhance old or small anime images
summary.what_it_does: ["Performs single-image super-resolution, enlarging images using deep convolutional neural networks.", "Is aimed at anime-style art and states that it also supports photos.", "Has an Art model, which the page says was updated on 2026-08-17.", "Links to a full demonstration and to the project's GitHub page.", "Offers the interface in many languages, including English, Japanese, and Chinese."]
notable: Specialized for anime-style art, with photo support
Open source project with code on GitHub
caveats: The page does not state pricing or whether the service is free.
The domain changed from waifu2x.udp.jp to www.waifu2x.net in 2024; the page notes this change.
Uses Google Analytics, according to the page.
